paramount-2024.every_line: Read line by line against the predecessor's own 10-K (CIK 813828, para-20241231.htm). Every line is a bold stand-alone line of Item 1A - the 'Risk Factors Summary' heading, the eight category labels the summary names (listed once, at their first occurrence, as the route publishes them) and the categories again over the detailed section - or the bold sentence that opens one risk factor and leads into its body. Each distinct line is a heading of Item 1A under the approved definition's heading-level list; the same judgement was made for Salesforce's 'Risk Factor Summary'. No heading-marked line in the item is missing. The one line the reading flags - emphasis resuming after a gap of two characters or fewer - is judged below from its own runs.

other_marks.judgement: NOT_A_HEADING: the italic tail of a quoted passage - it ends with a closing quotation mark and continues a sentence ('addition to, those that have historically affected ... Class B Common Stock.') inside the transactions risk factor's body.

short_gap_lines.line: Failures to comply with or changes in U
short_gap_lines.judgement: The same heading as the successor's 2025 report and the same shape: the bold runs stop at the two periods of the abbreviation 'U.S.' and resume after each, and the run across the gaps is the whole sentence 'Failures to comply with or changes in U.S. or foreign laws or regulations could have an adverse effect on our business, financial condition or results of operations.' The heading is that sentence; the prefix that stops at the first period cuts it inside a word.
